withdrawal.metadataDescription: Submit a withdrawal electronically to Kubikart and read information about the statutory right of withdrawal.
withdrawal.title: Right of withdrawal
withdrawal.intro: You can use this page to withdraw electronically from a contract concluded online. You may still declare your withdrawal by email or post.
withdrawal.functionIntro: The function guides you through the required information. You can review everything before submitting it.
withdrawal.name: Name
withdrawal.emailHelp: The acknowledgement will be sent to this address once transactional email is configured.
withdrawal.contractReferenceHelp: Where possible, enter the order number or another clear contract reference.
withdrawal.scope: Goods or parts of the contract concerned
withdrawal.scopeHelp: Optional. Leave blank if you wish to withdraw from the entire contract.
withdrawal.reviewIntro: Check your details. The next button submits the withdrawal declaration.
withdrawal.error: The withdrawal could not be stored safely. Please try again or send it to info@kubikart.de.
withdrawal.successText: Your withdrawal declaration was stored with its date and time of receipt.
withdrawal.emailSent: An acknowledgement was sent to your email address. A storable confirmation was also downloaded.
withdrawal.downloadNotice: A storable acknowledgement was downloaded. Keep it as evidence of submission.
withdrawal.rightParagraph1: You have the right to withdraw from this contract within fourteen days without giving a reason. The withdrawal period is fourteen days from the day on which you, or a third party named by you who is not the carrier, takes possession of the goods.
withdrawal.rightParagraph2: To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform Kubikart of your decision through a clear statement. You may use the electronic function above, email or post.
withdrawal.rightParagraph3: To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient to send the notification that you are exercising the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period expires.
withdrawal.consequences1: If you withdraw from this contract, we will reimburse all payments received from you, including delivery costs except additional costs caused by a delivery method other than the least expensive standard delivery offered, without undue delay and no later than fourteen days after receiving the withdrawal.
withdrawal.consequences2: We use the same payment method for reimbursement as for the original transaction unless expressly agreed otherwise. We may withhold reimbursement until we receive the goods or you provide evidence that you returned them.
withdrawal.returns: You must return the goods without undue delay and no later than fourteen days after notifying us. You bear the direct cost of returning the goods.
withdrawal.exclusionTitle: Exclusion of the right of withdrawal
withdrawal.exclusionText: In particular, the right of withdrawal does not apply to contracts for goods that are not prefabricated and for which an individual choice or decision is decisive for production, or which are clearly tailored to personal needs.
